mapper.sql: id, user_id, place_id, item_type, custom_place_id, name, address, lat, lng, category, rating, photo_url, tags, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO saved_places (id, user_id, place_id, item_type, custom_place_id, name, address, lat, lng, category, rating, photo_url, tags, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{placeId}, #{itemType}, #{customPlaceId}, #{name}, #{address}, #{lat}, #{lng}, #{category}, #{rating}, #{photoUrl}, #{tags}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT j.id, j.created_at, j.completed_at, jsonb_build_object('extraction', jsonb_build_object('candidates', COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object( 'name', c.value -> 'name', 'query', c.value -> 'query', 'address_hint', c.value -> 'address_hint', 'category', c.value -> 'category', 'mapSearch', jsonb_build_object('candidates', jsonb_build_array(mapped.value))) ORDER BY c.ord) FROM jsonb_array_elements( CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(j.result_payload::jsonb -> 'extraction' -> 'candidates') = 'array' THEN j.result_payload::jsonb -> 'extraction' -> 'candidates' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END ) WITH ORDINALITY AS c(value, ord) CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT jsonb_build_object( 'title', m.value -> 'title', 'address', m.value -> 'address', 'latitude', m.value -> 'latitude', 'longitude', m.value -> 'longitude', 'thumbnail', m.value -> 'thumbnail', 'thumbnailUrl', m.value -> 'thumbnailUrl', 'imageUrl', m.value -> 'imageUrl', 'photoUrl', m.value -> 'photoUrl', 'category', m.value -> 'category', 'placeMapping', jsonb_build_object( 'placeId', m.value -> 'placeMapping' -> 'placeId', 'thumbnail', m.value -> 'placeMapping' -> 'thumbnail')) AS value FROM jsonb_array_elements( CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(c.value -> 'mapSearch' -> 'candidates') = 'array' THEN c.value -> 'mapSearch' -> 'candidates' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END ) WITH ORDINALITY AS m(value, ord) WHERE jsonb_typeof(m.value -> 'placeMapping' -> 'placeId') IN ('string', 'number') AND btrim(m.value -> 'placeMapping' ->> 'placeId') <> '' ORDER BY m.ord LIMIT 1 ) mapped ), '[]'::jsonb)))::text AS result_payload FROM social_location_jobs j WHERE j.user_id = #{userId} AND j.status = 'COMPLETED' AND j.result_payload IS NOT NULL ORDER BY COALESCE(j.completed_at, j.created_at) DESC, j.id DESC

WITH user_trip_ids AS ( SELECT t.id FROM trips t WHERE t.owner_id = #{userId} UNION SELECT tm.trip_id FROM trip_members tm WHERE tm.user_id = #{userId} AND tm.status = 'ACCEPTED' ) SELECT a.place_id AS itemId, 'PLACE' AS itemType, t.id AS tripId, t.name AS tripName, t.cover_image_url AS tripCoverImageUrl, t.destination AS tripDestination, a.id AS activityId, a.day_number AS dayNumber FROM user_trip_ids ut INNER JOIN trips t ON t.id = ut.id AND t.is_deleted = FALSE INNER JOIN activities a ON a.trip_id = t.id WHERE a.place_id IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT CAST(a.booking_id AS VARCHAR) AS itemId, 'ACTIVITY' AS itemType, t.id AS tripId, t.name AS tripName, t.cover_image_url AS tripCoverImageUrl, t.destination AS tripDestination, a.id AS activityId, a.day_number AS dayNumber FROM user_trip_ids ut INNER JOIN trips t ON t.id = ut.id AND t.is_deleted = FALSE INNER JOIN activities a ON a.trip_id = t.id WHERE a.booking_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY tripName ASC, dayNumber ASC, activityId ASC
SELECT FROM saved_places WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND category IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(BTRIM(category)) = LOWER(BTRIM(#{category})) ORDER BY created_at DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM saved_places WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND category IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(BTRIM(category)) = LOWER(BTRIM(#{category})) )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM saved_places later USING saved_places earlier WHERE later.user_id = #{userId} AND earlier.user_id = #{userId} AND later.category IS NOT NULL AND earlier.category IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(BTRIM(later.category)) = LOWER(BTRIM(#{category})) AND LOWER(BTRIM(earlier.category)) = LOWER(BTRIM(#{category})) AND later.item_type = earlier.item_type AND later.place_id = earlier.place_id AND (COALESCE(later.created_at, TIMESTAMP 'epoch'), later.id) > (COALESCE(earlier.created_at, TIMESTAMP 'epoch'), earlier.id)
DELETE FROM saved_places WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND category IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(BTRIM(category)) = LOWER(BTRIM(#{category}))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO saved_place_marks (user_id, place_id, visited_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{placeId}, #{visitedAt}, #{visitedAt}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, place_id) DO UPDATE SET visited_at = COALESCE(saved_place_marks.visited_at, EXCLUDED.visited_at), updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at

INSERT INTO saved_place_marks (user_id, place_id, removed_at, updated_at) VALUES
(#{userId}, #{placeId}, #{removedAt}, #{removedAt})
ON CONFLICT (user_id, place_id) DO UPDATE SET removed_at = EXCLUDED.removed_at, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
